file_roles.evidence: doWork previously completed a request with a disconnect response as soon as networkClient.ready() was false; rewritten to keep unsent requests queued, retry, and fail only on real disconnect or expiry.
Adds override val unsentExpiryMs = config.requestTimeoutMs, required by the new abstract member in InterBrokerSendThread.

rationale: WriteTxnMarkers requests never complete on Windows. The old send loop treated a not-ready connection as an instant disconnect instead of waiting. The diff replaces that logic. The channel manager change is forced by it.
